newsitem.title: USA: US spot propane extends intraday gains late.
newsitem.headline: US spot propane extends intraday gains late.

text.p: U.S. spot propane prices extended their gains in late trade on Thursday, riding on cold weather concerns and strong NYMEX crude oil futures, players said.
"Eveyone is concerned about the cold weather," said one Houston broker, referring to forecasts calling for below to much below normal temperatures over the next 10 days throughout most of the U.S.
In the Midwest, spot propane prices rose another 1.25 cents to between 76.50 cents and 76.75 cents a gallon, after gaining 3.00 cents at midday.
Prompt barrels were done as high as 78.00 cents.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane rose 1.25 cents to 65.00/65.25 cents. It rose 3.50 cents at midday, players said.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
